summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Payroll Enhancement and Documents Send Methods. All 11 backend API tests passed (9 skipped due to initial empty employees). After creating test employee, verified all Manual Hours CRUD, Timesheet, Pay Period, and Transactions APIs work correctly. Frontend testing confirmed Payroll page with 4 tabs (Overview, Time Sheets, Manual Hours, Transactions), Add Hours/Transaction dialogs, and period selector all functional. Documents page Send dialog has 3 methods (Email PDF, Portal, As Form) working correctly. Team nav highlights correctly when on payroll page.

GET /api/payroll/hours.description: Returns manual hours entries with date filter support

POST /api/payroll/hours.description: Creates manual hours entry with calculated gross_pay based on employee hourly_rate

PUT /api/payroll/hours/{id}.description: Updates hours entry and recalculates gross_pay

DELETE /api/payroll/hours/{id}.description: Deletes hours entry, returns 404 for nonexistent

GET /api/payroll/timesheet.description: Returns consolidated timesheet combining job time entries + manual hours with overtime calculations

GET /api/payroll/pay-period (weekly).description: Returns 7-day pay period summary with regular/overtime hours and pay calculations

GET /api/payroll/pay-period (biweekly).description: Returns 14-day pay period with 80-hour overtime threshold

GET /api/payroll/balance/{id}.description: Returns balance summary: earnings - advances - payments

frontend_payroll_page_loads.description: Admin Payroll page loads with data-testid='payroll-page', summary cards, and 4 tabs

frontend_tab_overview.description: Overview tab shows Pay Period Summary table with employee data

frontend_tab_timesheet.description: Time Sheets tab has employee filter and date range filters

frontend_tab_manual_hours.description: Manual Hours tab has Add Hours button that opens dialog with employee/date/hours/task inputs

frontend_tab_transactions.description: Transactions tab shows transactions table with Add Transaction button

frontend_add_hours_dialog.description: Dialog has employee select, date, hours, task type, job (optional), description inputs

frontend_add_transaction_dialog.description: Dialog has employee select, type (earnings/advance/payment), amount, date, description

frontend_period_type_selector.description: Weekly/Bi-Weekly dropdown works, changes pay period range

documents_send_dialog_3_methods.description: Send Document dialog has 3 tabs: Email PDF, Portal, As Form

documents_email_pdf_method.description: Email PDF shows Include as Attachment toggle, Send PDF button

documents_portal_method.description: Portal shows Send Email Notification toggle, Send to Portal button

documents_as_form_method.description: As Form shows info about form creator, Create Form button

navigation_team_tab_highlight.description: Team nav item highlighted (bg-blue-50 text-gray-900) when on payroll page

navigation_payroll_subnav.description: Payroll visible in sub-navigation under Team along with Time Clock and Users

critical_code_review_comments: Manual hours CRUD properly calculates gross_pay = hours * employee.hourly_rate
Timesheet consolidates both job_time_entries and payroll_hours collections
Pay period summary correctly calculates overtime: 40hrs/week or 80hrs/biweekly threshold
Balance formula: earnings - advances - payments correctly implemented
Documents Send dialog has all 3 methods with distinct UI/buttons per method

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all UI elements, tabs, dialogs, and selectors functioning

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_John Smith employee (id: a09a5f8b-d1c0-4ba5-bf54-273ef16f26a6) with $25/hr rate, manual hours entries, earnings/advance/payment transactions. Created TEST_Contract_Template document for send dialog testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Payroll enhancement fully tested and working. Key new collections: payroll_hours (manual hours), payroll_transactions (earnings/advance/payment). Timesheet combines job_time_entries + payroll_hours. Pay period calculates overtime based on 40hr/week or 80hr/biweekly. Documents Send dialog has 3 methods: Email PDF (attachment toggle), Portal (notification toggle), As Form (redirects to form creator). Navigation correctly highlights Team tab when on payroll page.
